programme.title: Kiss Kis Ko
programme.desc: A group of young Indian men calling themselves Band of Boys decide to perform publicly, to share their talents India-wide, as well as to make a career for themselves. It seems the public is only interested seeing a group of girls perform.

programme.title: Mr White Mr Black
programme.desc: Before dying, Gopi's father asks him to find Kishen and hand over a piece of land. Gopi travels to Goa, where he is drawn into chaos by Kishen and his dangerous look-alike brother, the hoodlum Hari.

programme.title: Aashiq
programme.desc: Pooja and Chander fall in love and want to be together. However, since Pooja's alcoholic father would never approve, she decides to run away from her house but, unfortunately, lands in a brothel.

programme.title: Raja Ki Aayegi Baaraat
programme.desc: Raja rapes Mala and the court orders him to marry her. His family continues to torture Mala and attempts to kill her, but she manages to win over Raja and his family with her good deeds.

programme.title: Munna Baba(dub) (unakaga Ellam Unakka Tamil)
programme.desc: Sakthi, a rich spoilt brat falls for Indhu. His father, Vinu meets his friend Jayaganesh and they agree on a marriage proposal for their children. Sakthi wants to break the deal because he loves Indhu and wants to marry her, but he does not realise that Indhu is Jayaganesh's daughter. He tries to break the engagement by asking his cousins to misbehave and indulge in a fight. Ultimately in the end, the two get married.
